scenario: LSER.19.8 — the positive half of LSER.19.8_nullable_agg_unnarrowed. The same emit written `t.mean ?? 0.0` narrows `Float?` to `Float` ([LNUL.5.3], [LNUL.5.4] case b) and compiles. Together the pair shows the refusal is the nullability and not the series read or the slot: this one would fail too if the compiler refused every aggregation into a slot.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Float mutable

schema Out scope logical:
    k: String key
    avg: Float mutable

series Reading.v:
    mean sliding 10_min

rule r:
    Reading t
->
    emit Out logical k: "x" avg: t.mean ?? 0.0
